metadata.title: MediaClaw Pricing - Plans for Content Scraping & AI Ops
metadata.description: Choose the MediaClaw plan that fits you best. Core scraping features stay free, and advanced AI plus collaboration unlock when you upgrade.
metadata.keywords: MediaClaw pricing, subscription plans, social media scraper cost, AI content tools, team collaboration, data extraction pricing

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits you
pricing.description: Core scraping features stay free. Upgrade when you need advanced collection tools, Lark Base sync, and AI workflows.
pricing.tip: ✅ 7-day free trial for Pro, no credit card required  ·  30-day money-back guarantee

items.title: Free
items.description: For individuals who use it occasionally.
features: Deep single-note / video collection, ideal for saving high-value content one item at a time
Basic list collection from search and account pages
Local data pool storage with CSV and Markdown export
Watermark-free image, video, and audio download
Single browser device usage

items.title: Pro
items.description: For ongoing topic research, collection, filtering, and review.
items.label: Most Popular
features: Unlock enhanced collection: batch backfill body text, tags, engagement, attached media, and other detail data
Filter by comments, creator metrics, low-follower viral posts, and lead clues
Sync data to Lark Base to build a topic and content library
Includes 180 AI credits for competitor monitoring, topic analysis, long-tail keyword analysis, video transcripts, and content remixing
Single browser device usage

items.title: Team
items.description: For teams sharing data, collaborating, and monitoring continuously.
features: Includes 700 AI credits for ongoing competitor monitoring, topic research, and team AI analysis
Multiple members sync data to one Lark Base
Ideal for content teams, MCNs, brand marketing, and ops groups
Use on up to 3 browser devices simultaneously

items.title: Emergency Top-up Pack
items.description: For temporarily boosting AI analysis and monitoring quota.
items.label: Most Popular
features: 1,000 AI credits
For competitor monitoring, topic analysis, long-tail keyword analysis, video transcripts, and content remixing

Does not extend the plugin validity period; after membership expires, credits freeze without resetting and resume after renewal
